sources.note: Main homepage. Describes Greenway as a single-platform ambulatory solution with EHR, practice management, and patient engagement. AWS cloud-hosted. Over 30 years of healthcare IT innovation.
Company history: traces to Medical Manager (1977), merged with Greenway Medical Technologies in 2013 via Vista Equity Partners. Describes EHR, PM, and RCM as core offerings.
ONC mandatory disclosures page. Sparse — mentions certifications for EHR and PM but provides minimal product detail.

EHR solutions page. Describes specialty-specific personalization, simplified workflows, flexible clinical noting with AI, comprehensive reporting, Document Manager, Clinical Assist, and revenue optimization.
Practice management page. Enterprise Desktop for multi-site management, specialty templates, claim control, rules-based scheduling, automated eligibility checks, patient flow tracking.

Patient Connect platform details: Patient Communications (automated reminders, omnichannel messaging), Patient Scheduling (online booking, waitlist), Patient Registration (digital forms, mobile check-in), Referral Management, Feedback/Reviews, AI Chatbot call center.
Greenway Revenue Services — managed RCM offering. Revenue advisory, analytics, system configuration optimization. Positions as partnership with practice, not just software.
Clinical Assist — AI-enabled clinical documentation: ambient documentation, patient chart insights, agentic coding helpers, smart summaries, one-click note approval.
Intergy Suite brochure PDF. Could not render (binary PDF), but referenced in search results as describing integrated EHR+PM with specialty templates, lab integration, e-prescribing.
G2 reviews for Intergy. ~3.8/5 rating. Users praise customizable workflows and billing. Criticisms include learning curve and inconsistent support.
SelectHub review. Covers features including telehealth, cloud/on-premise deployment, 500+ templates, analytics, interoperability. Notes no Android app, limited telehealth screen-sharing.
Software Advice reviews. Users highlight billing efficiency, scheduling, and patient management. Some note ERA posting challenges.

SoftwareFinder profile. Pricing info, feature overview, specialty support list (cardiology, family practice, nephrology, neurology, gastroenterology, orthopedics, ENT, pain management, pediatrics, OB-GYN).
Wikipedia article on Greenway Health. Company history, Vista Equity Partners acquisition ($644M), merger of Greenway Medical Technologies + Vitera + SuccessEHS in 2013.
TrustRadius comparison of Intergy vs Prime Suite. Intergy rated higher for ease of use; Prime Suite rated higher for billing. Both are distinct Greenway products.
